query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM organization_limit_notification_events
            WHERE organization_id = $1
              AND notification_type = ($2::text)::limit_notification_type
              AND month_start_utc = (
                    date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
                    AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
              )
        ) AS "exists!: bool"
